_meta.purpose: AIML-based nowcasting of thunderstorm and lightning using atmospheric observations (DWR, INSAT-3D, IITM lightning, NWP CAPE/shear)
_meta.file_convention: .js files (React 19 + Tailwind CSS + Lucide + Recharts + Leaflet)
_meta.design_archetype: The Performance Pro / Dark Operational Mission Control (Radar meteorology aesthetic)

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never build generic centered layouts or simplistic flat gradients. Create authentic atmospheric depth through dark obsidian surfaces, 1px luminous tactical borders, and meteorological scan lines.

Dark operational mission-control theme: Anchor base on Deep Obsidian (#070B12, #0A0F1D) with Pure White text, Amber/Cyan radar accents, and strict IMD Warning palette (Green #22C55E, Yellow #EAB308, Orange #F97316, Red #EF4444).

Truth in Data State is mandatory: Every card, header, map overlay, and API response must visibly display a state badge: [LIVE | DELAYED | HISTORICAL | TEST | SIMULATED]. Pilot runs are strictly SIMULATED / REPLAY DEMO.

All interactive and informational elements MUST include robust kebab-case 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='role-toggle-operator', data-testid='timeline-play-btn', data-testid='alert-badge-red').
DO NOT use full-screen transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modal sheets, popovers, or floating headers. Use backdrop-blur-md with rich bg-slate-950/85 and 1px border-cyan-500/20.
Bilingual support (English / Hindi 'वायुदृष्टि'): Provide dynamic language toggles across all alerts, public safety recommendations (NDMA/IMD lightning safety), and operational widgets.

Role toggle (Operator vs Public): Operator view renders multi-source health, provenance (latency, flags, coverage), TITAN storm cell tracks table, per-lead verification (POD/FAR/CSI/ETS/HSS/Brier), and vertical cross-section diagnostic. Public view renders high-contrast, simple safety cards, countdown to storm onset, and district risk.

key_components.name: VayuDrishtiHeader
key_components.role: Global brand header with domain selector (Mumbai vs Delhi NCR), IST clock, role toggle (Operator / Public), language switcher (EN / HI), and primary SIMULATED badge.

key_components.name: RadarNowcastMap
key_components.role: Leaflet map centered on selected domain with custom dark cartography, togglable layers (Doppler reflectivity rings/sweep, INSAT-3D infrared cloud top, IITM lightning strike pulses, NWP CAPE contours, storm motion vectors, GeoJSON risk warning districts).

key_components.name: ForecastTimelineBar
key_components.role: 0-180 minute timeline scrub bar with 15-minute resolution (T0, T+15, T+30 ... T+180 min). Play/pause animation loop, scrub slider, and lead-time alert indicator.

key_components.name: OperatorSourceHealth
key_components.role: Live data provenance telemetry panel: DWR (Mumbai Colaba/Delhi Palam), INSAT-3D (KALPANA-IR), IITM Lightning Network, NCMRWF NWP CAPE, showing latency, quality flags, packet count, and state badges.

key_components.name: StormTrackingTable
key_components.role: TITAN/SCIT cell tracking table with Cell ID, Max dBZ, VIL (kg/m²), Centroid lat/lon, Speed (km/h), Bearing, and Split/Merge probability.

key_components.name: VerificationMetricsPanel
key_components.role: Per-lead nowcast calibration curves and contingency scores (POD 0.88, FAR 0.16, CSI 0.76, ETS 0.69, HSS 0.74, Brier Score 0.08) with interactive Recharts reliability diagram.

key_components.name: VerticalCrossSection
key_components.role: Radar reflectivity cross-section diagnostic tool (0-16 km altitude vs 0-80 km radial distance) highlighting freezing level (4.5 km) and storm top.

key_components.name: PublicSafetyAlertView
key_components.role: Public citizen safety dashboard: Immediate NDMA/IMD lightning safety rules (30-30 rule, avoid open fields, unplug appliances), simplified risk level, countdown to safe conditions, and verified CAP 1.2 alert broadcast.
